title: Mile Marker 0
concept: A trucker notices the mile markers on an empty highway are counting down to a number that isn't on any map.
setting: Empty desert highway at night, cab interior.
conflict: No exits; fuel dropping; markers falling faster than she drives.
escalation: The markers start showing her truck's plate number underneath.
reveal: Mile 0 is a roadside memorial with her name and tomorrow's date.
ending: Rosa pulls over to avoid reaching it. In the mirror, the memorial is now behind her — freshly planted flowers.

hooks.line: The mile markers on this highway are counting down. To what?
My licence plate is printed under the mile marker.
hooks.first_visual: Headlights on a sign with a plate number.

hooks.line: I could stop. But stopping is how you end up at mile zero.
The CB radio keeps reading out my distance to zero.
